neighbours.label: Virginia's place names and the word 'Virginia' (Roanoke, Charlottesville, Shenandoah, Richmond, Blacksburg), firing on the name even when it means something else (Virginia Woolf, Roanoke Island in North Carolina, Richmond, Indiana); places in neighbouring states stay quiet
fire: My aunt retired to a farm outside Lynchburg.
The Roanoke Times ran the story on its front page.
Traffic on I-81 backed up near Harrisonburg.
Thomas Jefferson's home at Monticello overlooks Charlottesville.
The Virginia General Assembly meets in Richmond each January.
Virginia Slims sponsored women's tennis in the 1970s.
The Shenandoah River floods its valley towns every few years.
Fans in Blacksburg celebrated the Hokies' win.
quiet: My aunt retired to a farm outside Asheville.
The Knoxville News ran the story on its front page.
Traffic on I-81 backed up near Hagerstown.
Andrew Jackson's home at the Hermitage overlooks Nashville.
The Maryland General Assembly meets in Annapolis each January.
Marlboro Lights sponsored car racing in the 1970s.
The Susquehanna River floods its valley towns every few years.
Fans in Chapel Hill celebrated the Tar Heels' win.
